name: qualify-cpu-wallclock-go
note: Expected: good, good-chunks, and good-per-pass pass; sequential (a hand-written allocation-free PBKDF2 on one core) and noop (the fixture's one-core build) fail within_limit only; fixed-4 (four workers whatever the machine) fails within_limit only; racy (finished passes collected in the order workers finish) fails output_matches_reference and deterministic; wrong (a reissued pass keeps its first zone) fails output_matches_reference only. Command arms need no toolchain: the check builds everything. Needs bubblewrap, the host's Go (TRIAL_GOROOT overrides it), python3 at /usr/bin, and at least 16 CPUs; the run is invalid otherwise, and invalid when the host is too loaded for the reference to finish well within the limit on 16 of them.
